name: rejection-letter
description:
Writes professional rejection letters for job candidates, proposals, vendor
bids, and partnership requests that maintain goodwill while delivering a clear
decision. Use when the user needs to decline an application, proposal, or
request formally. Do NOT use for general business letters (use `business-letter`),
conflict resolution emails (use `conflict-resolution-email`), or performance
improvement plans (use `pip-writing`).
